context: Adds Zod schema validation to the order creation endpoint, which previously passed the raw request body straight through.
explanation: A good defensive addition: the schema enforces types, required fields, a minimum item count, and bounds on free-text notes before createOrder ever runs, and safeParse returns a structured error instead of throwing, so malformed requests get a clean 400 with details rather than an unhandled exception or bad data reaching the order service.
